items.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: original collectible RPG apocalypse boss key illustration, portrait 1024x1536. Create a NEW original adult male character named Sahyeon, not a redesign or copy of an existing franchise character. Image 1 is the project's Kuon mood reference ONLY: inherit the cold controlled presence, elegant dark silhouette and richly illuminated game-art quality, not his face, exact hairstyle, clothes, red butterfly motif, or composition. Design a beautiful East Asian adult man about 28 with narrow calm eyes, straight brows, long soft black hair with a natural continuous flow and a loose low tie, no jagged layered hair plates. His face, body, hands and clothes must all use the SAME refined 2D anime drawing language and detailed painterly shading; no photographic face pasted on an anime body. Three-quarter full figure with legs visible, commanding gaze toward camera. Clothing: tailored charcoal long coat over asymmetrical pale ivory layered textile and slim obsidian ceramic shoulder plates, one dark wine lining, fine antique-gold seams, no headband, no ninja uniform, no cloud pattern, no high red-lined cloak. One hand raised near his face and the other gently open. His supernatural irises are pale gold fractured optical lenses: unequal broken arcs plus four short offset radial slits, clearly no comma marks, no pinwheel, no familiar manga eye symbol. Behind and around him towers his OWN monumental protective apparition 'Hollow Icon': a faceless ivory-glass oracle with a suspended hollow chest, elongated hands, floating curved glass lamellae and an asymmetric broken lens halo. It is a giant protective spirit, not samurai armor, not a ribcage skeleton, no demon helmet, no sword. One immense translucent hand folds a veil of dark amethyst light across the ruined observatory battlefield. Establish the giant apparition's readable head and torso above the human, with striking scale and depth, human remains the foreground focus. Restrained ivory-gold and smoke-amethyst palette with fine wine highlights, drifting glass fragments, immense moonless observatory arches, dark low values with precise luminous edges. Dramatic polished collectible RPG splash illustration, elegant not overloaded. No text, labels, logos, watermark, UI frame, or recognizable existing IP elements.

Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: transparent full-body 2D RPG battle sprite of the NEW original character Sahyeon in the reference artwork. The reference is a character identity and costume reference only. Recreate ONLY THE HUMAN on genuine transparency, absolutely no background, no giant apparition, no floor, no text, no portrait crop. Show entire head, flowing hair, both hands, entire coat and BOTH FEET with 10% empty margins on all sides. Natural elegant game SD proportions about 4.7 heads high, adult masculine beautiful face and slim long legs, not baby chibi. Camera three-quarter front with face and body directed LEFT because he is a boss on the right side of the battlefield. Neutral poised ready stance with feet separated, one hand calmly raised near chest and the other opened toward the left. Preserve reference black hair with natural continuous soft strands, low-tied long hair, charcoal coat with wine lining, ivory layered inner textile, restrained gold chains and obsidian shoulder plate; simplify tiny trim for gameplay readability. Face, body, hands and clothing use the same clear refined 2D anime shape language and painterly shading. Pale gold lens-shaped irises, no comma or pinwheel symbols. Clean silhouette, sharp silhouette alpha, rich forms without excessive particles or glow. Keep all cloth and hair within image bounds. Transparent RGBA output.

Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: transparent 2D RPG ultimate summon sprite, the 'Hollow Icon' apparition behind Sahyeon in the reference. Use the reference ONLY to preserve this newly designed guardian's identity and pale ivory-glass gold material. Make ONE isolated immense upper-body guardian on genuine transparency, complete head, full hollow torso, both arms and ALL fingers visible within generous 12% margins. No human summoner, no background, no floor, no black rectangle, no text. A beautiful faceless oracle with an unmarked elongated mirror mask, long flowing crystal ribbons, an asymmetric broken lens halo, an OPEN hollow suspended chest and long slender glass hands extended to the lower left and lower right as if slowly closing an enormous invisible lens between them. Elegant sculptural semi-transparent ivory glass with antique-gold seams and restrained smoke-amethyst energy in the hollow chest, readable pale solid edges. NO helmet, no samurai armor, no skeleton ribs, no sword, no known franchise motif. Refined 2D anime RPG painted style unified across body and head, high shape clarity at 400px tall. Portrait composition 1024x1536, reserve visible margins for later animated positioning. The pose is frontal with a slight three-quarter left turn; both hands reach inward toward an empty central space below its chest. Transparent RGBA output.

Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: ONE isolated transparent 2D game spell sigil, Sahyeon's original lens-eye symbol 'Hyeonmun'. A large circular magical iris with an elongated narrow vertical light pupil, three unequal incomplete concentric rings made from floating beveled ivory glass sectors, and FOUR short offset radial slit marks at irregular positions. Original optical instrument / shattered observatory lens design. No comma marks, no tomoe, no pinwheel, no shuriken, no triangle, no familiar manga/franchise eye symbol. Thin elegant antique-gold illuminated edges and a little smoke-amethyst inner refraction, clean broad empty alpha between sectors, strong simple silhouette readable at 120px, very restrained external glow. Exact front view, centered square composition with at least 15% transparent margin on each edge. NO face, no background, no black rectangle, no vignette, no lettering, no numbers, no UI border. Painterly polished 2D RPG effect texture, not photoreal or 3D render. Genuine transparent RGBA PNG.

Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: wide cinematic EYE SKILL CUT-IN for the original RPG character Sahyeon from the reference. The reference is face and hairstyle identity only. Make a tightly composed widescreen crop of his two eyes, brows, upper nose bridge and a few flowing black strands, no full body, no clothing, no giant guardian.
